Element.Description: Resource name of the string table used for the credits. Every string becomes a scrolling text entry rendered with EnglishFont, FontColor and FontOutlineColor.
Total duration used to calculate credits scroll speed. Scrolling lasts this value minus the longer of MovieFadeTime and TextFadeTime; the full text travel distance is divided by that scrolling time.
Seconds used to fade the scrolling credits text to transparent after scrolling finishes or the player dismisses the credits. Also contributes to the scroll duration calculated from TotalTime.
Seconds used for the credits movie's fade-in and fade-out. Also supplies the music fade parameter and contributes to the scroll duration calculated from TotalTime.
